name: @cavalry/mac
description: Cavalry local finance tracker for macOS and Windows.
author: Cavalry

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests vite.*.config.mjs vitest*.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:renderer
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run licenses:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --arm64
scripts.pack:mac:intel: npm run build && npm run licenses:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run licenses:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:intel: npm run build && npm run licenses:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:mac: npm run build && npm run licenses:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.yml --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:release:windows: npm run build && npm run licenses:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.windows.yml --win --x64 --publish never
